description: 국가철도공단_경강선_역간거리 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 포함된 항목은 철도운영기관명, 노선명, 역명, 역간거리로 구성되어 있어 열차 운행 간격 설정, 소요 시간 예측, 요금 체계 설계 등 철도 운영 전반에 실질적인 도움이 됩니다. The portal shows 2025-11-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
